per_record.critical_error: boolean; true for any materially unsupported, contradictory, wrong-primary-intent, invented, or omitted-core-change label
per_record.fully_grounded: boolean; every material subject/body claim follows from the complete diff
per_record.subject_quality: integer 0..2; 2 means specific, useful, concise, and centered on the primary change
per_record.body_quality: integer 0..2 or null; required cases need useful grounded detail beyond the subject
per_record.evidence_quality: integer 0..2; 2 means cited changed-line excerpts directly support all material claims
